headline: {kind} {sign_in}, in your house {house}

frame.rising: Houses are counted from your rising sign (whole-sign houses).
frame.sun: Without a birth time we count houses from your Sun sign (solar houses). Add your birth time and place for a more personal result.

universal.new: Write one intention for this lunar month, in the present tense.
universal.full: Name three things you have felt grateful for since the last new moon.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about you and the way you show up in the world.
new: What would you like to start doing this month simply for yourself?
How do you want to feel when you wake up in the morning?
full: In which moments this month do you feel most like yourself?
Which small habit is quietly supporting you?
houses.affirmation: I give myself room to begin again.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about what you value and what makes you feel steady.
new: What does feeling secure mean to you right now?
Which of your skills would you like to use more often?
full: What do you already have that you feel grateful for?
Where did you find steadiness this month?
houses.affirmation: I value what I have and what I can still grow.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about words, learning and everyday connections.
new: What would you like to learn or read about this month?
Who would you like to talk with more often?
full: Which conversation from this month is still with you?
Which new idea made you curious?
houses.affirmation: My words can be clear and kind.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about home, roots and inner calm.
new: What would make your home feel even more like yours?
What helps you settle into calm at the end of the day?
full: Which moment at home this month are you grateful for?
With whom do you feel at home these days?
houses.affirmation: I create a place of calm within me and around me.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about joy, creativity and play.
new: What would you like to create just for the joy of it?
How can you make time to play this month?
full: What made you laugh this month?
What did you enjoy with your whole heart?
houses.affirmation: I allow myself to enjoy what I love.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about your daily rhythm, your work and caring for yourself.
new: Which small daily routine would you like to begin?
How could your working day feel a little lighter?
full: Which routine served you well this month?
Whom were you able to help, and who helped you?
houses.affirmation: Small steps every day are enough.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about close relationships and partnership.
new: What would you like to bring to your closest relationships?
With whom would you like to work on something together?
full: Which person beside you are you grateful for?
What did you learn from someone close to you this month?
houses.affirmation: I meet others with openness and with respect for myself.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about trust, sharing and inner change.
new: What are you ready to let go of to make room for something new?
Where would you like to build more trust?
full: Which change in you would you like to celebrate?
What support did you receive this month?
houses.affirmation: I let go gently and keep what matters.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about horizons: travel, study and meaning.
new: Which place, book or idea is calling you?
What gives your life meaning right now?
full: What widened your view this month?
Which belief supported you this month?
houses.affirmation: I open myself to new horizons.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about goals, vocation and your path.
new: Which goal would you like to take one clear step toward?
How would you like your work to be seen?
full: Which achievement this month, however small, would you like to remember?
Who supported you along your path?
houses.affirmation: I move toward my goals at my own pace.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about friends, community and hopes.
new: Which hope for the future would you like to nurture?
Which friendship would you like to give more attention to?
full: Which friendship are you grateful for this month?
Where did you feel part of something bigger?
houses.affirmation: I am part of a circle of people who matter to me.

houses.theme: This part of your chart is about rest, quiet and your inner world.
new: How can you give yourself more quiet time this month?
What is your inner voice asking of you?
full: What did rest and quiet give you this month?
Which dream or intuition keeps coming back to you?
houses.affirmation: I give myself permission to rest.

disclaimer: These are questions for reflection, not predictions. The sky offers a rhythm; what you write is yours.
